explanation: The dataset-change route now tells builders to pass every track of a study to one writeDatasetBundles call (merged study files and derived QC counts, nSig at P<0.01) and to build sidecar intakes through buildIntakeStudies with staged publish, --check and --only. The September 5 builder is a hook on that pipeline; geo, batch2 and normalized builders no longer compute nSig, arm counts or is3v3. The HFD and OXT/AVP builders are unchanged because their intake audits fingerprint them.
